a.xlink:title: Main UI rendering entry point.
Renders active notifications to the screen.
Renders the sample distribution as an ASCII graph for logs/overlays.
Safe wrapper around vsnprintf to format strings with bounds checking.
Calculates the arithmetic mean of all samples in the current window.
Draws the debug overlay with performance metrics and settings.
Draws a single text string at a specific coordinate.
Returns true if an effect is currently active.
Draws the help overlay with keyboard shortcuts.
Initializes a layout helper for a frame.
Draws text and advances the layout cursor.
Draws a rotating loading spinner.
Draws text with custom alpha transparency.
Activates the program for subsequent draw calls (glUseProgram).
Retrieves a uniform location via binary search on the cache.
Computes the luminance histogram from current frame data.
Draws exposure-specific debug text.
Renders the luminance histogram as a graph on screen.
Draws a solid color rectangle.
Draws a solid color rectangle with custom alpha transparency.
Adds vertical space to the layout.
